title: Hinomori Shizuku — Butterflies Not To Forget〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's just us at the moment, so let's fill that survey out here before we start practice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'd appreciate that.
Minori and I were just saying it'd probably be difficult to fill it out on the rooftop.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see, we're supposed to be answering questions from the Idol Question Box, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah! I saw the questions from last week, and there were lots of interesting ones!
Like, “What do you think you were in your past life?”
Or, “Would you rather be the protagonist or deuteragonist?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: How we answer them is going to be key to making the most of those interesting questions.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ahh, my variety show heart is on fire!
Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (“What animal would you want to be if you were going to be kept as a pet?”)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(If I were to be a pet... Maybe a cat?
But then I couldn't play with Airi, since she's allergic.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (An animal that doesn't easily trigger allergies, is easy to take care of, and can go on walks...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I know! How about a piggy? They're so cute with their curly tails!)

rows.Speaker: Question 5
rows.Line: “If you could go back to any point in the past, when would you choose?”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh... Well, I was feeling a bit lost on how I should answer the “If you could go back to any point in the past, when would you choose?” question.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that one.
I also had some trouble deciding how to answer that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it's for a variety show, so the response should be something fun to hear, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm, something fun to hear...?
I guess that means the one I came up with isn't quite right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...?
If you don't mind, could you tell us what you wrote?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Sure.
My answer to “If you could go back to any point in the past, when would you choose?” was “That summer in junior high”...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: See, there's something I really really regret, so much that I still have dreams about it sometimes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That must be a pretty deep regret...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Just thinking about it has me all frustrated again...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Seriously! Past me, why didn't you save up so you could buy that ASRUN anniversary merch...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because of you, I was never able to complete my collection of behind-the-scenes Haruka photos...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ahh... Was that the one where the photo was either “common”, “rare”, or “secret”...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, that's the one!!!
If I'd just gotten that secret one, my collection would've been complete!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well, that was totally different from what I was expecting...
Anyway, I think that's a fine moment to talk about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree. I feel a little guilty saying this, Minori, but I can't help but smile when I try to imagine you back then.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh...
If it's okay, I think I'll stick with this answer!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Minori.
With your help, I've figured out how I should answer this question.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hehe, you're welcome!
And I'm glad I got to have you all check my response!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haruka... Do you have a copy of that secret bonus photo?
If we hand it to her during the show, we could make a great moment happen...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I was thinking the same thing.
I'll look and see.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That should be about it for the survey.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, right. Airi said she was going to, um...scan our responses and send them in, so I have to remember to give her mine tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I could go back to the past...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (For the survey, I ended up writing about the time Shii and I got lost back in preschool.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'd appreciate the chance to redo all that since I put Shii in a situation that made her feel so helpless, but...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But if I really could go back to the past, I'd...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If I start thinking about all the “ifs”, there'll be no end to it.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...?
I saw this sudden flash from my phone, and now I'm in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How strange.
I don't think I was touching it or anything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That light was the same as...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, someone's dropped something here.
It's glowing bright... Could this ball be some sort of decoration?
